metadata.short_desc: Connect AstrBot to a self-hosted Nami agent server.
metadata.desc: Connects AstrBot to Nami, a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible AI agent server: direct bridge commands, an optional auto-reply listener, and a WebUI console page.

nami_base_url.hint: The /v1 suffix matters, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1 . Used by /nami ask and by auto reply.

nami_host_root.hint: Used for /healthz, /readyz and /admin/api/*. Must be the root, without a trailing /v1, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787 .

nami_api_key.hint: One of Nami's NAMI_API_KEYS. When empty Nami answers 401 missing_api_key.

nami_admin_token.hint: Nami's NAMI_ADMIN_TOKEN, required for /admin/api/* (tool and session listings). Leave empty when Nami has no admin token.

default_model.hint: Empty lets Nami pick its own default. When set it must exist in GET /v1/models.

request_timeout.hint: Longest wait for a single Nami call. 60-120 is sensible for local models.

system_prompt.hint: Optional. Prepended as a system message to every request from this plugin.

session_scope.hint: Controls how X-Nami-Session is derived: user (per sender), group (per chat, private falls back to user), global (one shared Nami session).

enable_commands.hint: When off the /nami command group reports that it is disabled; the Dashboard page and auto reply are unaffected.

admin_only.hint: When on, only AstrBot administrators may use the /nami command group.

auto_reply_enabled.hint: Off by default. When on, every matching message triggers a Nami request and burns tokens and compute. Read the README warning first.

auto_reply_trigger.hint: mention: only when mentioned or when the keyword appears; prefix: only when the message starts with the prefix; all: every non-empty message (highest token cost).

mention_keyword.hint: With auto_reply_trigger=mention, a message containing this word also counts as a mention (for platforms without reliable @). Empty means platform @ only.

max_reply_chars.hint: Replies longer than this are truncated so they do not flood the chat or get rejected by the platform.

nami.title: Nami Console
nami.description: Inspect Nami health, readiness, models, tools and sessions, and ask questions directly.
